title: How Should Planning Agents ReSHAPE Their Search Space?
abstract: arXiv:2611.16466v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Planning agents and benchmarks treat a user's initial specification as fixed. Yet the requests users write exclude plans they would gladly take, since they rarely discover the possible trade-offs they would accept until seeing the options. Agents already revise requests through interaction, but whether this helps planning is unknown. We formalize this step as the ReSHAPE task, which judges a revision by whether its search space matches the acceptable plans and a planner finds one there. Using ReSHAPE Planter, which builds instances from planning benchmarks with a human-validated simulated user, we analyze 5,800 agent-revised specifications in travel and shopping. We find that reshaping matters: one correct trade-off makes the same planner reach an acceptable plan up to 4.6x as often, and search space quality predicts what the planner finds. translated_title: 规划智能体应如何重塑其搜索空间？
translated_abstract: 规划智能体和基准测试通常将用户的初始规格视为固定不变。然而用户写下的请求往往排除了他们本乐意接受的方案，因为他们在看到可选选项之前，很少能发现自己愿意接受的各种权衡。尽管智能体已经能够通过交互修订请求，但这种做法是否有助于规划尚不清楚。我们将这一步骤形式化为 ReSHAPE 任务，该任务通过修订后的搜索空间是否与可接受方案相匹配、以及规划器能否在其中找到可接受方案来评判修订的质量。我们利用 ReSHAPE Planter（基于规划基准构建实例，并采用经人工验证的模拟用户）分析了旅行和购物场景中 5,800 个由智能体修订的规格说明。研究发现，重塑搜索空间确实很重要：一个正确的权衡能让同一个规划器找到可接受方案的概率提升至多 4.6 倍，且搜索空间的质量可以预测规划器能找到什么。然而，当前智能体的搜索空间最多只包含 32% 的可接受方案，而单凭那一个权衡就能包含……
tldr: 本文提出 ReSHAPE 任务来评估规划智能体通过交互修订用户请求、重塑搜索空间的能力，发现一个正确的权衡能使规划器找到可接受方案的概率提升至多 4.6 倍，但现有智能体的搜索空间最多只覆盖 32% 的可接受方案。
en_tdlr: This paper formalizes the ReSHAPE task for evaluating how planning agents revise user requests to reshape their search space, showing that one correct trade-off can boost a planner's success rate up to 4.6x, while current agents admit at most 32% of the acceptable plans.
